notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone! After the first public version I read a lot of your feedback and watched playthroughs. Based on that, I’ve [b]significantly reworked the demo.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]What’s new:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]New level.[/b] Designed to better communicate what the game is about.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Run button + fewer dialogs.[/b] Spend less time walking and reading, more time solving.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reworked visual style.[/b] Updated palette, contrast, and lighting with color-theory in mind.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Hope you enjoy the update![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3769000/Sophie_in_the_Tangled_World_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
